opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to committing tokens, mining, and recruiting others into the network. Viewers are told, "Are you in the mining queue? You need to be," while another explanation states that whoever enters mining with tokens "will still receive the split." The opportunity is framed as urgent and financially advantageous: "start mining your coins TODAY. The earlier you mine, the cheaper you get." Participants are also told to bring packages into the business and to attract new miners, while the presentation promotes "a sustainable value of the coin of over 50 E in 3-5 years." Taken together, these are active appeals to purchase or commit tokens for paid mining and anticipated coin value, not a neutral technical demonstration.
